//: OPTIONAL batch alternative to the API's in-process schedule, NOT a requirement. By default the `serve` role already crawls daily at 01:00 CRAWL_TIMEZONE, so this file is for deployments that would rather bill per running minute than keep the cadence inside an always-on service. To use it: deploy this repo as a SECOND service with this file as its config path, set Settings -> Cron Schedule to '0 18 * * *' (18:00 UTC = 01:00 WIB), and set CRAWL_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=false on the API service so the two do not both wake up for the same slot. The role runs ONE INCREMENTAL cycle -- OAI-PMH from= and WordPress modified_after= scoped to the last successful run -- so a quiet day costs ~1 minute, then bumps the BM25 index version and exits; the API picks the new artifact up from Postgres within INDEX_POLL_SECONDS with no redeploy.

deploy.//: NEVER restart: a cron job is supposed to exit; ALWAYS would relaunch it forever.
